rules.direction: From batch 5 (2026-10-18) new themes are commercial and practical (finance and insurance, schools and kindergartens, manufacturing, corporate sites, clinics, associations), never Japan-only subjects (basketry, kimono, wagashi, shrines, tea ceremony, dojo, crafts, pottery, tabi and the like). Since 2026-10-20 (#226) every theme is designed for one fictional brand from its brief (themes/<slug>/brand.md), the way Asa Linen, Hari Tailor and Amane Wagashi were: a low-chroma ground (off-white, stone, ink or deep night) with one muted accent, a large photograph leading the first screen, narrative paragraphs rather than tables or fields, refined serif or humanist display type at 4.25rem or more. Restrained, never a poster: no saturated full-bleed colour fields, no cut-out objects breaking frames, no side rails, no giant centred type, no collages. Look and layout may repeat between themes when the brand calls for it; what must not drop is quality (rules.quality_gate).
rules.industry_unique: Each new row names an industry not used by any other theme or plan row, and its first-screen photograph shows a different subject from the rows beside it. No other dimension (archetype, hero, nav, palette, fonts, first screen, page structure) has a no-repeat rule.

quality_gate.applies_to: Every new theme from b6-3 on; mark it with "quality_gate": 2 in theme-meta.json so scripts/check-themes.mjs enforces the static checks. Not meeting the gate means the theme is not merged.
quality_gate.brand_brief: themes/<slug>/brand.md written before any design: name, location, founding year, 1-3 named people, audience, tone, a day in the life. All copy grows out of it.
quality_gate.copy: Home page >= 250 English words with >= 3 narrative paragraphs of >= 20 words each. >= 8 pages and >= 1 post in demo-content.json.
quality_gate.photos: >= 12 unique photo files in assets/images (cut-outs excluded), all generated with one shared STYLE string for a realistic photography look (same light, same tones); the home page has >= 8 photo positions.
quality_gate.cutouts: At most 1 cut-out (transparent-background image) in the whole theme; optional.
quality_gate.type: The largest theme.json fontSizes entry is >= 4.25rem.
quality_gate.first_screen_colour: In the 1440x900 first screen, saturated pixels (HSV S > 35% and V > 24%) cover no more than the smaller of 30% and the share measured on the palette's S5-Style reference site (rules.palette_from_reference; before 2026-10-20 17:41 the limit was 15%). Measure with python3 scripts/check-first-screen.py screenshots/home-desktop.webp --max <limit>.
quality_gate.navigation: Exactly one top menu in the header; no side rail and no second navigation.
quality_gate.comparison: Before merging, put the first screen and full home page next to Asa Linen, Hari Tailor and Amane Wagashi and compare quality (type size, whitespace, photo share, amount of narrative), not look-alike; fix what falls short.
quality_gate.checked_by: scripts/check-themes.mjs (pages, posts, photo files, cut-outs, largest font size, brand.md, home words / paragraphs / photo positions, single top menu) and scripts/check-first-screen.py (first-screen saturation).

rules.batch6: From 2026-10-19 new themes are English only (en sample content, no zh-TW/ja/fr/de). Batch 6 (rows b6-1..b6-16, 2026-10-20): commercial industries, real photography only (photographic=true; illustration column = photo direction). Open rows were re-mapped on 2026-10-20 (#226): photo-led heroes, top header only, real-photography, a one-sentence signature instead of a wireframe; every row must pass rules.quality_gate (theme-meta.json "quality_gate": 2).
rules.palette_from_reference: Since 2026-10-20 17:41 (owner): the palette is taken from one or two of the theme's S5-Style reference sites, keeping their relation and proportions of main, secondary, ground and accent colours (the hue may shift to fit the brand, but the source must stay recognisable). It overrides a plan row's palette/hex and its 'quiet palette, first-screen saturated <= 15%' note. Do not default to beige or cream grounds. The share of saturated pixels in the 1440x900 first screen follows the reference's measured share and never exceeds 30%: run python3 scripts/check-first-screen.py on the reference screenshot and on the theme, pass --max <the smaller of 30 and the reference value>, and write both numbers in gate.md, brand/reference.md and the PR. Avoid the high-chroma full-bleed failures of 10/15: the result must look as mature as the reference. brand/reference.md lists the colour source site, its hex values and shares, and the theme's matching hex values.

nav_note: Every theme has one real global top header (site title/logo + primary nav + CTA) and no other navigation: no side rail, no second menu. centered/split/overlay describe how that one menu is arranged (overlay = the menu opens over the page, e.g. on phones).
image_note: real-photography = photorealistic photography-style images generated with Grok Build (scripts/grok-image.sh), all from one shared STYLE string per theme (lens, light, tones, grain) so the set reads as one shoot; natural, low-chroma colour, no grading toward a palette colour; no stock fetching. The illustration column holds a photo direction (enums.photo_direction) on photographic rows. At most one cut-out per theme (rules.quality_gate); illustration, collage, clay or isometric images are never the main visual. enums.illustration is kept for the history rows only.

page_structures.fits: Retired. Batch 5 rows b5-1 to b5-7 only; never assign to a new row.
blocks: home-hero: main-colour field, eyebrow + 4-line headline left, two buttons, 'asked this month' 01-03 list, one framed photo right
home-works: 'Four kinds of X' heading + one large image + four room cards (or 01-04 rows with thumbnails)
home-serial: colour band with a giant founding year, 'It began with...' story, photo collage
home-process: 'Four steps' row of four photo cards
home-journal: three latest posts as cards
footer: dark band, big wordmark, hours, address, links
page_structures.differs: This is the pattern every new structure must avoid.

page_structures.fits: consultancies, advisers, single-service B2B firms, specialist clinics
blocks: statement: the client's problem in one sentence beside a large photograph
problem: three symptoms as a short hairline list
method: three principles as numbered text paragraphs
proof: one case with before/after figures and one quote
who: short team paragraph with one portrait
single CTA band with a short form link
page_structures.differs: Reads as one argument from top to bottom; no service grid, no news, one CTA only at the end.

page_structures.fits: accounting and law offices, agencies, IT service firms with many services
blocks: full service index: numbered hairline rows (name | one line | for whom | link), grouped in 3-4 groups
how to engage: three one-line options (spot, retainer, project)
sectors served as a plain text list
contact strip with phone and form
page_structures.differs: The directory list is the spine of the page; a photograph still leads the first screen and each group has a short narrative.

page_structures.fits: construction, renovation, admissions, custom manufacturing, onboarding-heavy services
blocks: headline + total duration of the engagement
vertical timeline: steps 1..n with sticky step numbers (what you do / what we do / time)
deliverables per step as a table
page_structures.differs: The steps are the spine of the whole page, not a four-card row near the bottom.

page_structures.fits: academies (student projects), studios, contractors, agencies
blocks: one featured case read in three columns (question / what / result)
page_structures.differs: Proof comes before any self-description; no story band, no year numeral.

page_structures.fits: construction, manufacturing, finance, logistics, public bodies reporting performance
blocks: headline with one key figure beside a large photograph
metrics ledger: rows of number | what it measures | year | note
register/table of recent projects or results
page_structures.differs: Numbers lead and are set as a ledger/table, not as cards or a story.

page_structures.fits: insurance, clinics, admissions offices, SaaS support, legal help
blocks: photograph-led opening with a short question prompt below it
page_structures.differs: Questions are the navigation; content is answers, not marketing sections.

page_structures.fits: IT services, SaaS, insurance plans, memberships, fee-based schools
blocks: three-plan comparison table with sticky header
diagram parts / services explained as numbered rows
onboarding steps in one compact line
page_structures.differs: A decision table sits at the centre of the page.

page_structures.fits: schools, clinics, professional firms, care services
blocks: headline over a large photograph of the people at work
portrait index of people with names and roles
the year or programme as a compact list
page_structures.differs: People are the primary content; services are secondary.

page_structures.fits: logistics, multi-branch clinics, retail chains, real estate
blocks: full-bleed hero with a lookup bar (track / find nearest)
network map beside the hub list
page_structures.differs: Geography drives the page: map, hubs and coverage before services.

page_structures.fits: colleges, universities, hospitals, associations with members and companies
blocks: path detail sections with next-step lists
page_structures.differs: The visitor picks a path first; everything below is sorted by audience.

page_structures.fits: associations, schools, municipalities, cooperatives
blocks: dated notice board with category tabs
this month's events as a date list
take part: join / volunteer / donate rows
page_structures.differs: A chronological feed is the primary content and the reason to return.

page_structures.fits: premium manufacturers, architects, consultancies with a philosophy
blocks: four alternating text/image rows (60/40, sides swap)
summary list of what you get
page_structures.differs: Long zig-zag reading rhythm with no grids, no cards and no tables.

page_structures.fits: manufacturers, packaging, parts suppliers, B2B product lines
blocks: product spec table (after a photographic opening)
custom order flow with lead times
page_structures.differs: A data table is the backbone of the page, set below a photograph of the product in use, never in the first screen.

page_structures.fits: care homes, kindergartens, schools, gyms, day clinics
blocks: day line hero (time marks across the screen)
page_structures.differs: Time of day is the axis of the page.

page_structures.fits: dental/medical clinics, salons, driving schools, any appointment-first service
blocks: live booking card (mid-page, after a photographic opening) (date strip, slot chips, service select)
page_structures.differs: The page is a tool first: the visitor books before reading anything.

page_structures.fits: driving schools, studios, courses, fixed-fee services
blocks: fee menu (mid-page, after a photographic opening) (3 priced strips)
page_structures.differs: Itemised prices lead; unlike plan-comparison it is a menu of separate products, not tiers of one product.

page_structures.fits: mortgage, loans, solar, insurance quotes, freight
blocks: interactive calculator (mid-page, after a photographic opening) (inputs, live result)
how it works in three steps
page_structures.differs: The visitor's own numbers are the content; the CTA follows the result.

page_structures.fits: hotels, product ranges, service levels, rooms and units
blocks: comparison strip (mid-page, after a photographic opening) (3 columns)
full comparison matrix with sticky heads
page_structures.differs: Compares options of the same offer side by side; unlike plan-comparison there is no recommended tier or diagram.

page_structures.fits: check-up centres, clinics, advisers, schools choosing courses
blocks: short question card (mid-page, after a photographic opening) (4 steps)
page_structures.differs: A guided choice replaces browsing: the page answers 'which one is for me'.

page_structures.fits: architects, long-established firms, institutions, research bodies
blocks: horizontal history timeline (mid-page, after a photographic opening) (year ticks, active card)
page_structures.differs: Chronology of the organisation or its work is the spine; unlike process-timeline it is history, not an engagement process.

page_structures.fits: clinics, language schools, law and consulting firms with many specialists
blocks: filterable directory of people (mid-page, after a photographic opening) (filters + card grid)
page_structures.differs: A searchable roster of specialists is the content; unlike people-story it is a tool with filters, not interviews.

page_structures.fits: managed IT, security, logistics, utilities, SaaS-like B2B services
blocks: KPI dashboard tiles (mid-page, after a photographic opening) (numbers, sparklines, status)
page_structures.differs: Live-looking operational tiles prove the service; unlike metrics-ledger the numbers are widgets with trend and status, not a ledger table.

page_structure_note: Optional hints, not rules: page_structure (see page_structures), first_screen, and on older rows wireframe and page_structure_blocks only suggest an order and a first-screen skeleton. The brand brief decides the home page; reusing a good pattern approach from Asa Linen / Hari Tailor / Amane Wagashi is fine. Functional components (booking card, calculator, quiz, search box, spec or comparison table, directory, dashboard tiles, map) never fill the first screen; at most one sits mid-page. Every page structure still has photographs and narrative paragraphs and must pass rules.quality_gate. legacy-hero-works-serial-process-journal and legacy-text-left-framed-photo-list describe b5-1..b5-7 (history).
